svg.title: Pixel versus latent diffusion cost
svg.desc: A 512 by 512 by 3 pixel image has 786,432 numbers; a 64 by 64 by 4 latent has 16,384: about 48 times fewer per denoising step.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Latent diffusion: ≈ 48× fewer numbers per denoising step
